integrity: Analytical proof accompanied by exact-rational, symbolic and finite numerical reproduction; numerical tests do not prove universality. Independent review has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: Finite fixed weighted trees, one complete ordered edgewise midpoint sweep; asymptotic constants are not uniform in vertex count. No general cyclic-graph, nonlinear, or crossover-uniqueness result. Literature comparison leaves possible unlocated equivalent formulations.
title: The stiff-sweep spectral law and a path–star mixing reversal for edgewise midpoint diffusion on trees
